title: CARE: Multilingual Human Preference Learning for Cultural Awareness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to culture-specific questions across five dimensions (cultural entities, cultural commonsense, social norms, opinions, and literacy) using native language prompts and scoring them for cultural appropriateness via human annotations and an LM-as-a-judge framework.

Comparing model performance and search engine retrieval quality on culture-specific questions when prompted in native languages (Chinese, Arabic, Japanese) versus English to measure cross-lingual alignment gaps.
